answer: Per-identity escrowed obligation: on enrollment the protocol banks a lottery-seeded lotus deposit that clears only when a sponsor the enrollee neither funds nor controls settles it. Each seat needs a distinct sponsor with independent skin in the game, and sponsorship capacity per real participant is capped, so N clones need N unshared sponsors: the attacker's bill grows quadratically while sockpuppet yield stays linear. Clones cannot pool the trick, and a sable ocean of lookalike wallets just multiplies the sponsors owed.
